mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_no, t.task_type, t.warehouse_id, w.code AS warehouse_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, t.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, t.batch_no, t.qty, t.location_id, l.code AS location_code, t.from_location_id, fl.code AS from_location_code, t.wave_id, v.wave_no, t.source_type, t.source_no, t.assignee, u.nickname AS assignee_name, t.status, t.recommend_reason, t.finish_time, t.remark, t.create_time FROM wms_task t LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = t.material_id LEFT JOIN base_location l ON l.id = t.location_id LEFT JOIN base_location fl ON fl.id = t.from_location_id LEFT JOIN wms_wave v ON v.id = t.wave_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.wave_id = #{waveId} ORDER BY (l.code IS NULL), l.code ASC, t.task_no ASC

SELECT c.source_type, c.source_id, c.source_no, c.warehouse_id, c.material_id, c.batch_no, SUM(c.qty) AS qty FROM (
SELECT 'PUR_IN' AS source_type, h.id AS source_id, h.instock_no AS source_no, h.warehouse_id, d.material_id, d.batch_no, d.qty FROM pur_instock h JOIN pur_instock_detail d ON d.instock_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 AND h.audit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) UNION ALL
SELECT 'SAL_RET', h.id, h.return_no, h.warehouse_id, d.material_id, d.batch_no, d.qty FROM sal_return h JOIN sal_return_detail d ON d.return_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 AND h.audit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) UNION ALL
SELECT 'OTH_IN', h.id, h.no, h.warehouse_id, l.material_id, l.batch_no, l.qty FROM inv_other_in h JOIN inv_other_in_line l ON l.other_in_id = h.id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 1 AND h.audit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) UNION ALL
SELECT 'PROD_IN', w.id, w.order_no, w.warehouse_id, w.material_id, '', (w.finish_qty - w.bad_qty) FROM mrp_work_order w WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 'FINISHED' AND w.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL AND w.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) ) c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status != 40 AND t.source_type = c.source_type AND t.source_id = c.source_id AND t.material_id = c.material_id AND t.batch_no = c.batch_no) GROUP BY c.source_type, c.source_id, c.source_no, c.warehouse_id, c.material_id, c.batch_no LIMIT 200

SELECT c.source_type, c.source_id, c.source_no, c.warehouse_id, c.material_id, c.batch_no, SUM(c.qty) AS qty FROM (
SELECT 'SAL_OUT' AS source_type, h.id AS source_id, h.out_no AS source_no, h.warehouse_id, d.material_id, '' AS batch_no, d.qty FROM sal_outstock h JOIN sal_outstock_detail d ON d.out_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 10 AND h.audit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) UNION ALL
SELECT 'OTH_OUT', h.id, h.no, h.warehouse_id, l.material_id, l.batch_no, l.qty FROM inv_other_out h JOIN inv_other_out_line l ON l.other_out_id = h.id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 1 AND h.audit_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysBack} DAY) ) c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status != 40 AND t.source_type = c.source_type AND t.source_id = c.source_id AND t.material_id = c.material_id AND t.batch_no = '') GROUP BY c.source_type, c.source_id, c.source_no, c.warehouse_id, c.material_id, c.batch_no LIMIT 200

SELECT l.id AS location_id, l.code AS location_code FROM base_location l WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 1 AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND (l.loc_type IS NULL OR l.loc_type != 'DEFECT') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_stock s WHERE s.location_id = l.id AND s.material_id = #{materialId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0) ORDER BY l.code ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.id AS location_id, l.code AS location_code, l.capacity FROM base_location l LEFT JOIN base_zone z ON z.id = l.zone_id AND z.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT location_id, SUM(qty) AS used_qty FROM inv_stock WHERE deleted = 0 AND location_id > 0 GROUP BY location_id) occ ON occ.location_id = l.id WHERE l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 1 AND l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND (COALESCE(l.loc_type, 'STORAGE') = 'STORAGE' OR (z.zone_type IS NOT NULL AND z.zone_type = 'STORAGE')) AND (l.capacity = 0 OR COALESCE(occ.used_qty, 0) < l.capacity) ORDER BY (occ.used_qty IS NULL), l.code ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.batch_no, s.location_id, l.code AS location_code, s.qty FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_location l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.location_id > 0 AND s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.material_id = #{materialId} AND s.qty > 0 AND (l.loc_type IS NULL OR l.loc_type != 'DEFECT') ORDER BY s.qty DESC, l.code ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, t.finish_time)) AS avg_minutes, SUM(DATE(t.finish_time) = DATE(t.create_time)) AS on_time FROM wms_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 30 AND t.finish_time >= #{beginTime} AND t.finish_time < #{endTime}

SELECT t.assignee, u.nickname AS assignee_name, COUNT(*) AS completed, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, t.finish_time)), 1) AS avg_duration_minutes FROM wms_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 30 AND t.assignee IS NOT NULL AND t.finish_time >= #{beginTime} AND t.finish_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY t.assignee, u.nickname ORDER BY completed DESC
